'''Vorli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was affiliated with a resistance group that opposed the [[Cult of Veroleem]], a religious sect that ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veroleem]]. At some point, Vorli departed Veroleem to search for some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who would be willing to help the resistance to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] some recently-liberated victims of the cult off of Veroleem. Vorli suffered some serious injuries during the course of his mission and when he eventually located a group of suitable spacers, he ran toward them and [[Death/Legends|died]] of his wounds before he could speak with them. A [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that Vorli had been carrying fell from his hands and was subsequently recovered by the spacers.<ref name="TUR" />
